text:
**My default pick: [BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W solar panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit).** It has a 2,073.6 Wh battery—enough, according to the cited guide, for a fridge and CPAP through a day and night—and supports up to 1,000 W of solar input if you add panels later. The listed price is $1,199 before any discount; prices and availability can change. ([kit details and pricing](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-hurricane-season))

If you only need to keep smaller essentials powered and want to spend less, the guide lists the [BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit) at $729. It has less capacity, so it’s a less comfortable choice for running a fridge through a long outage.

One hurricane-season caveat: don’t count on solar panels to recharge during the storm itself. Charge the battery fully beforehand, and check that your essential appliances’ power needs fit the unit.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
